Beneficiary.heading: Reserved for you
Beneficiary.hint: You can see that a file exists, never what it contains, until the guardians release it. Funds show their amount, which is public on the blockchain.
Beneficiary.loadFailed: Could not load your files. Retrying…
Beneficiary.emptyTitle: Nothing is reserved for this address
Beneficiary.emptyHint: When someone reserves a file for you, it appears here. Make sure you have registered your encryption key and shared your address with them.
Beneficiary.ownerActive: The owner has been active recently. A claim can be raised in {duration}.
Beneficiary.ownerChangedGuardians: The owner changed guardians and has not re-shared this file yet.
Beneficiary.ownerFroze: The owner has frozen this vault.
Beneficiary.zkClaimNote: The owner requires you to prove your identity (zero-knowledge) to raise this claim. You will be asked for your Aadhaar QR; it never leaves your browser.
Beneficiary.ageNote: Finalizing will also need a proof that you are over 18. Only that one fact is proven.
Beneficiary.zkClaimTitle: Prove your identity to raise this claim
Beneficiary.zkClaimIntro: The owner asked that only the verified person behind this wallet can start a claim. The proof is made for this claim only and cannot be reused.
Beneficiary.zkAgeTitle: Prove you are over 18 to finalize
Beneficiary.zkAgeIntro: The owner asked for proof that the beneficiary is an adult. This proves that single fact, and is made for this claim only.
Beneficiary.noReviewerKey: A guardian or the owner has no registered encryption key
Beneficiary.claimMoved: Another claim was raised while your proof was being made, so it no longer matches. Please try again.
Beneficiary.claimFailed: The claim transaction did not go through.
Beneficiary.finalizeFailed: The finalize transaction did not go through.
Beneficiary.fewShares: Only {have} of {need} required shares are available
Beneficiary.cannotDecrypt: Could not decrypt: the released shares do not reconstruct a valid key
Beneficiary.integrityFailed: INTEGRITY CHECK FAILED: decrypted file does not match the on-chain hash
Beneficiary.verifiedLetter: Integrity verified ✓ — the letter matches the SHA-256 recorded on-chain.
Beneficiary.verifiedFile: Integrity verified ✓ — "{name}" ({bytes} bytes) matches the SHA-256 recorded on-chain.
